    Critical pieces carry point–brick data #

    For a critical piece: all indecomposable projectives lie in the preprojective component (goodProj_piece), because the points whose projective lies in it form an arrow-closed, hence convex, set containing the support of the component. Then AR.DirData.exists_pointBrick gives point–brick data on a minimal quotient. They inflate to the piece (pointBrick'_critical). This proves PointBrickData.
